question: 品牌为中国邮政的邮局有多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pois p WHERE p.subtype = 'post_office' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM poi_tags t WHERE t.poi_id = p.id AND t.key = 'brand' AND t.value = '中国邮政')

question: 标注为基督教的宗教场所有多少处？
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pois p WHERE p.subtype = 'place_of_worship' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM poi_tags t WHERE t.poi_id = p.id AND t.key = 'religion' AND t.value = 'christian')

question: 简称“陆指”的学校正式名称是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM pois p JOIN poi_tags t ON t.poi_id = p.id WHERE t.key IN ('alt_name', 'old_name', 'short_name') AND t.value = '陆指'

question: 栖霞区有多少家星巴克（按品牌标签）？
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pois p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM poi_tags t WHERE t.poi_id = p.id AND t.key = 'brand' AND t.value = '星巴克') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM districts d WHERE d.name = '栖霞区' AND ST_Within(p.geom, d.geom))

question: 小区“银城东苑”的占地面积是多少公顷？
gold_sql: SELECT ST_Area(geom::geography) / 1e4 AS area_ha FROM residential_areas WHERE name = '银城东苑'

question: 白鹭洲公园的周长是多少米？
gold_sql: SELECT ST_Perimeter(geom::geography) AS perimeter_m FROM parks WHERE name = '白鹭洲公园'

question: 从云南路地铁站步行到鼓楼地铁站，最短步行距离是多少米？
gold_sql: SELECT walk_m FROM (WITH a_p AS (SELECT t.geom AS pt FROM metro_stations t WHERE t.name = '云南路' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), a AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid FROM a_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), b_p AS (SELECT t.geom AS pt FROM metro_stations t WHERE t.name = '鼓楼' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), b AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid FROM b_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v) SELECT max(agg_cost) AS walk_m, max(agg_cost) / 80.0 AS walk_min FROM pgr_dijkstra('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT vid FROM a), (SELECT vid FROM b), false)) r

question: 奥体中心地铁站步行 15 分钟（4.8 km/h，可达道路两侧 50 米缓冲）可达范围有多少平方公里？
gold_sql: WITH o_p AS (SELECT t.geom AS pt FROM metro_stations t WHERE t.name = '奥体中心' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), o AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid FROM o_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), reach AS (SELECT node FROM pgr_drivingDistance('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT vid FROM o), 1200, false)), e AS (SELECT e.geom FROM walk_edges e JOIN reach r1 ON r1.node = e.source JOIN reach r2 ON r2.node = e.target) SELECT ST_Area(ST_Transform(ST_Union(ST_Buffer(ST_Simplify(ST_Transform(geom, 32650), 2), 50, 'quad_segs=2')), 4326)::geography) / 1e6 AS area_km2 FROM e

question: 南湾营泰康苑小区步行 5 分钟（4.8 km/h）内有几个公交站点（站点记录）？
gold_sql: WITH o_p AS (SELECT ST_PointOnSurface(t.geom) AS pt FROM residential_areas t WHERE t.name = '南湾营泰康苑' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), o AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid FROM o_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), reach AS (SELECT node, agg_cost FROM pgr_drivingDistance('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT vid FROM o), 400, false)), fac AS (SELECT t.id, t.name, t.geom AS pt FROM bus_stops t WHERE TRUE AND ST_DWithin(t.geom::geography, (SELECT pt FROM o)::geography, 400)), snapped AS (SELECT f.id, f.name, v.id AS vid FROM fac f CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> f.pt LIMIT 1) v), hit AS (SELECT s.id, s.name, r.agg_cost AS walk_m FROM snapped s JOIN reach r ON r.node = s.vid) SELECT count(*) AS n FROM hit

question: 按 GB 50180-2018 对初中服务半径的要求，诚品城小区沿步行路网是否有中学？
gold_sql: WITH cl AS (SELECT clause_id, max_radius_m AS r FROM standard_clauses WHERE clause_id = 'GB50180-2018:C.0.1:初中'), o_p AS (SELECT ST_PointOnSurface(t.geom) AS pt FROM residential_areas t WHERE t.name = '诚品城' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), o AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid FROM o_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), reach AS (SELECT node, agg_cost FROM pgr_drivingDistance('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT vid FROM o), (SELECT r FROM cl), false)), fac AS (SELECT t.id, t.geom AS pt FROM pois t WHERE t.subtype = 'school' AND t.name LIKE '%中学%' AND ST_DWithin(t.geom::geography, (SELECT pt FROM o)::geography, (SELECT r FROM cl))), snapped AS (SELECT f.id, v.id AS vid FROM fac f CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> f.pt LIMIT 1) v), hit AS (SELECT min(r.agg_cost) AS m FROM snapped s JOIN reach r ON r.node = s.vid) SELECT (hit.m IS NOT NULL) AS compliant, cl.clause_id, cl.r AS radius_m FROM hit, cl

question: 按国标公交车站服务半径，青秀城小区是否被公交站覆盖（沿步行路网）？
gold_sql: WITH cl AS (SELECT clause_id, max_radius_m AS r FROM standard_clauses WHERE clause_id = 'GB50180-2018:C.0.1:公交车站'), o_p AS (SELECT ST_PointOnSurface(t.geom) AS pt FROM residential_areas t WHERE t.name = '青秀城' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), o AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid FROM o_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), reach AS (SELECT node, agg_cost FROM pgr_drivingDistance('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT vid FROM o), (SELECT r FROM cl), false)), fac AS (SELECT t.id, t.geom AS pt FROM bus_stops t WHERE TRUE AND ST_DWithin(t.geom::geography, (SELECT pt FROM o)::geography, (SELECT r FROM cl))), snapped AS (SELECT f.id, v.id AS vid FROM fac f CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> f.pt LIMIT 1) v), hit AS (SELECT min(r.agg_cost) AS m FROM snapped s JOIN reach r ON r.node = s.vid) SELECT (hit.m IS NOT NULL) AS compliant, cl.clause_id, cl.r AS radius_m FROM hit, cl
